# Continuous_Memory_System

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A memory architecture that operates as a continuous dynamical system, enabling seamless integration of storage and computation without discrete memory boundaries. Enables in-network memory that evolves with data flow, critical for achieving real-time adaptive behavior in TCC/iNEST hardware.
